decisions.reason: Removing quotation marks from one referenced paragraph is already captured by the content-integrity Requirement and does not change the copyediting Requirement's existing editorial goal, sentence-clarity rule, or meaning-preservation rule.
The source concerns quotation marks in a referenced paragraph, not the unintended newline-marker text in the book title.
The source does not identify the referenced paragraph as a Mama's Hot Take section and therefore does not change that section's italic styling or established quotation-mark treatment.
Removing quotation marks from a paragraph does not change the required back matter or author lines.
The paragraph punctuation change has no effect on image distortion, cropping, or pixelation requirements.
Removing quotation marks from a paragraph does not alter the deferred paragraph-spacing or body-page-density requirements.
The punctuation change does not alter any requested guidance about paperback publication prerequisites or copyright.
The source does not affect image sourcing, suitability review, book-tone fit, or colour-palette alignment.
The referenced paragraph is not identified as a chapter heading or the Chapter 18 first line, so its quotation-mark removal does not change heading typography.
The paragraph punctuation change does not affect the cover image, trim size, preferred cover visual, or unresolved cover-design choice.
Removing quotation marks from a paragraph does not change pagination, table-of-contents page numbers, or their update timing.
